data.name: Hafijur
data.gender_notes: Hafijur is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hafijur is derived from the Sanskrit and Bengali languages. It is a combination of two words: Haf (wisdom, knowledge) and Ijur (protector). Therefore, Hafijur means a wise protector. This name is deeply rooted in the Hindu tradition and is often given to boys who are believed to have the potential to become wise leaders and protectors.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Hafijur represents the divine qualities of wisdom, knowledge, and protection. It is believed that a child named Hafijur will be blessed with the ability to understand complex concepts and use this knowledge to protect and serve others. This name is also associated with the Hindu deity Ganesha, who is known as the remover of obstacles and the protector of knowledge.
data.etymology: Hafijur belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hafijur total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
